summary: Decompose ticket-response parsing to clear god-function smell in context

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm God Function smell for the reported lineage of src/koru/context.py:462 (planfile PLF-031, reported as 'build_context' CC=9/fan-out=20/mutations=23). The evidence snapshot predates ticket-213 (120509a0) and ticket-244 (84318d61): build_context itself is already under every threshold at HEAD, but ticket-213's extraction moved the reported 23-mutation block verbatim into the helper _parse_ticket_response (lines 423-467, containing the cited line 462), which is still flagged (CC=10, fan-out=10, mutations=23). Fix: _process_list_payload and _process_dict_payload return the existing _TicketFetch NamedTuple instead of bare tuples (tuple-unpack targets are double-counted by the mutation metric - 10 of the 23 records); _parse_ticket_response returns _TicketFetch with one direct return per response shape (idle banner/empty/JSON-null, non-JSON garbage, list payload, dict payload with follow-up history fetch, scalar-JSON fall-through) instead of mutating four accumulator locals; the idle-output probe is extracted to _is_idle_planfile_output; _fetch_ticket_data (sole caller) drops the tuple re-pack. Behavior-preserving. _process_list_payload keeps its pre-existing mutations=8 - a separate unreported dedupe key at :339, out of scope. No duplication report exists in this repository (no project/duplication.toon.yaml), so the duplication checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, message, schema or public-interface change
No restructuring of _process_list_payload internals (its mutations=8 is a separate smell instance with its own future dedupe key at :339)
No changes outside src/koru/context.py and tests/test_context.py

architecture.decision: Keep the ticket-fetch pipeline shape; replace bare-tuple contracts between _parse_ticket_response and its two payload helpers with the existing _TicketFetch NamedTuple and make each response shape return directly.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm FileAnalyzer on src/koru/context.py, base vs head content>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm FileAnalyzer on the file AST. Base reports _parse_ticket_response CC=10, mutations=23 (matches the ticket's reported mutation count at the cited line region); head reports CC<=6, mutations<=3 - under every god threshold (fan-out>10, mutations>6, CC>12). New helper _is_idle_planfile_output lands at CC<=4, mutations=1. build_context stays CC=4, mutations=6. No other function in the file newly crosses a threshold.
Full context suite (idle, JSON-null, list, dict, fixture filtering, error paths, rendering) green, including the new scalar-JSON fall-through pin; ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
